# coal.ui — AI agent instructions

## Registry
coal.ui is a shadcn-compatible component registry.
Registry URL: https://ui.chlohal.com/r

## Installing components
To install coal.ui components into a React + Tailwind v4 + shadcn project:

1. Install the theme first (run once per project):
   npx shadcn add https://ui.chlohal.com/r/theme.json

2. Install any component:
   npx shadcn add https://ui.chlohal.com/r/{name}.json

   Available components: button, input, card, badge, dialog, select, tabs, tooltip
   Available blocks:     hero-block, dashboard-shell

## Using the shadcn MCP server
The official shadcn MCP server (https://mcp.shadcn.com) works with coal.ui
without any custom configuration. When a user asks to add a coal.ui component,
specify the URL:
  https://ui.chlohal.com/r/{name}.json

## Token customization
All colors use OKLCH custom properties. Override in globals.css:
  :root {
    --primary: oklch(52% 0.27 264);  /* change primary color */
    --radius: 0.75rem;               /* change border radius */
  }

## Component source
All component source is available at: https://github.com/chlohal/coal-ui
Documentation: https://ui.chlohal.com/docs/installation
